reviews.text: Our cat Bazooka stayed there for several weeks, and we were more than satisfied with how his stay went! Lots of playtime, cuddles, and souvenir photos, all in a perfectly suited and extremely well-maintained environment! Thank you for him!

Our little Hubert spent three days here. The place is very spacious and well-equipped, and the owner was very friendly and gentle with him. I received updates and videos halfway through his stay. It's worth noting that food and litter are provided, which makes logistics much easier. I highly recommend it.
A lovely cat daycare where everything is done for the well-being of the animals. I've been leaving my beloved Luna there for four years with complete peace of mind. Thank you to Jeanne and her team!

Hello, first of all, thank you so much for your kindness, your welcome, and to everyone who works with you. The atmosphere, the friendliness, the cleanliness, and especially Mathylde and her colleague and the other people who work at Maison des Ron Ron daycare for kittens, I highly recommend La Maison des Ron Ron. You will be warmly and charmingly welcomed by Mathylde and her colleagues. Bravo to you!

I left Choupette for a two-day weekend so she could get used to the place and to Jeanne. The stay went very well, and I was able to leave the following week with complete peace of mind. I received videos or photos of Choupette almost every day.

The place is bright, spacious, and perfectly suited to cats. Very clean and odor-free.

I noticed that Jeanne regularly cleaned her eyes. She is a gentle and caring person. You can tell she loves cats and puts her whole heart into caring for them.

Jeanne's cat-sitting service is fantastic. I've only been leaving my cat there for three months, but "La Maison des Ronrons" (The House of Purrs) will remain my cat's favorite daycare! A huge thank you!
I highly recommend it; I leave my cat there every summer, sometimes even longer. They take good care of our cats. It's reassuring for owners.
A fantastic stay for my little Baya, everything was perfect from beginning to end, thank you to the whole team at Maison des Ronrons, you are wonderful, see you very soon.

I entrusted my cat to Jeanne twice and was delighted with the service. I immediately sensed the affection she has for the cats in her care. The animals are very pampered and kept in a very pleasant and spotlessly clean environment. My cat is used to living outdoors, so I was worried about her staying indoors for several days, but she was very happy. I would entrust Billie to her again without hesitation.

Our cat had a fantastic two-week stay!! Jeanne is incredibly attentive, the facility is spacious and bright, everything is there to make cats feel comfortable! I highly recommend La Maison des Ronrons!!
My cat is staying with us again at the end of May 2026, and we're still very happy with the boarding service. We also appreciate receiving updates via photos and videos during her stay.

My cat has stayed at La Maison des Ronrons several times.
The manager, Jeanne, is very friendly and attentive to her guests. She regularly provides updates with photos.

The staff took excellent care of our pets, from arrival and departure to departure. They were pampered and their attention was always evident. My cat, Bandi, had a small scratch on his nose, and they thoughtfully called me to apply coconut oil to help it heal. I appreciated the gesture and the photos they sent. I knew my cat was in good hands during my stay. Thank you again to the whole team! See you soon!
The cat daycare was a very good experience for my cat. The team is kind, attentive, and really friendly. You can immediately tell that the animals are in good hands.

Hello to all you kitties!
I'm Bastet, and I stayed at the Purr House holiday camp from February 23rd to March 2nd, 2026.
It was wonderful, a lovely house, and a very kind lady in the cafeteria who was also a photographer and videographer. I think she sent my photos and videos to my mom, who was very worried about leaving me, so I told her, "Everything's fine, it was great! A big house with bright rooms, plenty of food, my litter box cleaned, my peace and quiet respected, and she even listened to me when I spoke (she's the one who said I'm chatty). Anyway, Mom, I'm going back as soon as possible!"
So, my kitty friends, tell your humans to take you to the Purr House. You'll be perfectly happy there.
I can't wait to go back!
Great cat daycare. My cat Simba loves going there and the very friendly people make you feel comfortable from the start.

For two years now, Eden, my little bundle of love, has been staying at the Purr House. Shy and timid at first, now he comes out of his carrier and makes himself right at home. So much so, that he doesn't want to leave! 😅 The service is perfect, the staff attentive and responsive. I love the decor. The new arrivals are a welcome change; I have no worries. I feel confident, and so does Eden 😻.
Thank you, Jeanne and Mathilde, for everything you do for my Purr. See you soon!

Despite Tsuki's shyness, the stay went very well!

I want to emphasize the staff's dedication and commitment to animal welfare.
These women know how to meet our little pets' need for attention as well as space!

I recommend them without hesitation!

This is Pix's third stay at the cattery, and it's still hard to get him to come home because he's so happy to be with other cats.

I highly recommend this cat daycare!
A true holiday resort for cats who are pampered by a team of enthusiasts, I highly recommend them for looking after your 🐱 …

A fantastic experience! We were a little anxious about leaving our cat for this first introductory stay, but the team was amazing. You can feel their genuine warmth and love for animals. The little extra that made all the difference: the updates we received during our stay, which allowed us to be completely at ease. Thank you again for your warm welcome!

I highly recommend La Maison des Ronrons!
A warm welcome, great professionalism, and a genuine love for cats. My cat was pampered, and I received regular updates. Thank you again!

Hello to all the humans who read this message, I'm Arrakis the cat and I wanted to share my personal experience at the House of Purrs.

It's a fantastic place (unlimited food, plenty of beds, very helpful staff) that I highly recommend for a vacation away from home. However, Jeanne treats me like an influencer by filming me daily. I don't know who receives these videos, but what about my right to privacy?

Meow yours, and I hope to see you at the House of Purrs.

Arrakis the cat
I left my cat at the cattery for a week during the December holiday period. It went very well! Professional and attentive staff. Great experience!

It's been almost three years since we started boarding our cat Toshi. Although he's very shy and timid, we always find him healthy and reassured. The boarding service is excellent, and the regular updates sent via WhatsApp are very reassuring. We highly recommend La Maison Des Ronrons! 🙂 …

Top-notch boarding! I left my little Minouche, my 2-year-old cat, and picked him up happy, healthy, and gorgeous. I highly recommend them. The staff are very welcoming and warm, but above all, they take excellent care of our furry friends and are full of cuddles! I recommend them 100% without hesitation!

This is the second time I've left my cat at La Maison des Ronrons (I left her this summer for about two weeks) and between Christmas and New Year's. Each time it went very well, and she comes home in great shape.
Jeanne is very attentive to the well-being of her guests and their owners too! She sends photos and updates regularly during their stay. It's really appreciated!

I highly recommend them!!

We've entrusted our little cat to La Maison des Ronrons twice, and we've been very happy with the experience. The place is spacious and welcoming, and the staff are very attentive and responsive. We'll definitely use Jeanne and her team again for our next vacation!

At the end of 2025, I had my cat looked after over the holidays on December 24th and 31st.

On New Year's Eve, despite having an appointment scheduled for noon, the facility was closed when I arrived. We had to wait outside for a long time in the cold, without any prior notice.
During the stay, I received very little communication (only once in total). I had to follow up myself and then received a message indicating that updates were provided regularly, but not daily.
When I picked up my cat, he was asleep, seemed lethargic, and wasn't meowing. Once we got home, his condition deteriorated significantly: he still wasn't meowing, seemed very tired, and was breathing with his mouth open. I therefore had to take him to the emergency vet that same evening.

I had to pay both the boarding fees (€188) and the emergency veterinary fees (€182.40), for a total of €370.40.

When I contacted Maison des Ronrons afterward, they refused to acknowledge any responsibility. They also told me that the updates had been provided "free of charge," whereas many pet daycares charge for this service, which seemed inappropriate in this context.
This experience was very disappointing and, above all, worrying for my pet's well-being. I do not recommend this daycare.

A fantastic discovery trip for my two kittens, one of whom is extremely timid by nature. After returning home, I saw a huge change in her confidence and shyness! Even though she didn't dare go outside around humans during the trip, she had a real breakthrough once she got back. I highly recommend it for shy cats!

I left my cat Naïa at the cattery for two weeks while I had renovations done at home. It went very well; I received photos and videos regularly, and the 48-hour stay beforehand also helped. Thank you so much!

It was a first for my cat, who stayed at the introductory cattery.

But it was a very good experience at La Maison des Ronrons (The House of Purrs). There are three large rooms, one of which opens onto the street.

It's a communal space without individual private areas for each cat, which is exactly what I was looking for to stimulate my cat. Even though he didn't bond with the other cats, the space is large enough for him to feel comfortable. Jeanne was very pleasant during all our interactions and reassuring throughout the stay (photos, quick responses, etc.).

Banjo and I are delighted.
It was with some trepidation that I left Banjo, my 6-month-old kitten, at La Maison des Ronrons for his 2-night, 3-day settling-in stay. I had previously spoken with Jeanne by phone.
I was able to meet Jeanne and Coline when Banjo arrived. The boarding facility is clean and well-maintained.

The welcome was warm, with plenty of explanations and genuine kindness.
Jeanne and Coline clearly love cats and know their work and their feline guests well. 😜
I received updates with photos and videos throughout his stay.
When I came to pick up Banjo, he seemed comfortable.
The stay went smoothly.
I picked him up in excellent condition: just as playful and cuddly as before, with a good appetite and no issues whatsoever.
I left him feeling peaceful and I'm delighted to be able to rely on La Maison des Ronrons to take care of Banjo during my next vacation.

For the second time, we entrusted our cat to Jeanne for four weeks this summer, with complete peace of mind since he had a wonderful stay last year. This year again, we received regular updates from Jeanne, and our feline friend was reunited with familiar friends, all while enjoying the air conditioning! He didn't lose any weight (we weighed him, no doubt), and came home in top form, his fur still soft and shiny! Jeanne returned him to us with a recap of all his quirks and little habits, which are exactly the same ones we know from home 😅 We thank her for her attentive care and all the cuddles she gave him while we were away… he'll be back for Christmas and next summer without hesitation! Thank you so much, Jeanne!

A sublime place 🤩 where my little darling always has a wonderful holiday, with superb decor.
Jeanne is professional, lovely, and caring. She is always attentive to our needs and pampers all the cats at the cattery as if they were her own. I highly recommend this place 🥰 …

We entrusted our Yuzu to the Maison des Ronrons (House of Purrs), and it was his first time there. Yuzu initially had a "discovery stay," unfortunately coinciding with a gastroenteritis outbreak, which worried us a bit, but we were kept informed; it's a risk in a group setting, and we have to accept it. We picked up Yuzu a little disoriented, which is normal for a first-timer.

Then came the longer period of his vacation. We were kept informed of his condition very regularly, with photos and videos. Jeanne and Coline took excellent care of him; it was a long time, and we were a little stressed... So, we were apprehensive about the return, but Yuzu immediately settled back into his routine and was instantly very affectionate! We picked him up healthy and happy to see us again!

A huge thank you to the Maison des Ronrons, whose team showed great professionalism and kindness towards Yuzu 😻 while reassuring us throughout this stay!

Our little Winter (1 year old) first had a 3-day, 2-night introductory stay at the end of August, which proved challenging for him (first time with other cats, lots of cats in August, first nights without us…). He seemed very stressed, and the return home was difficult (he stopped eating, and we suspected tracheitis with the vet because he spent a long time huddled on the air conditioner up high…). Jeanne was very kind and reassured us; for her, it was a classic case of stress, but overall, the introductory stay went well.

Two weeks later, Wiwi returned to the cattery for two weeks this time. Despite our initial apprehension, the second stay went wonderfully! A huge thank you to Coline and Jeanne who knew how to make Winter feel at ease, reassure him, and give him enough attention, affection, and familiar surroundings for him to quickly settle down and have a wonderful stay (I think having fewer cats around also helped). We received videos and photos every day, which was a real bonus! It was so reassuring to see him comfortable, interacting with other cats and the girls, watching him play, and so on. The return home also went very well; Winter was thrilled to see us again and quickly found his bearings. Honestly, we have nothing but praise. He'll be back! Thank you again, ladies, you knew how to reassure us and take such good care of our beloved "son."

We leave our dog Gustave with her whenever we're away from Lyon for more than three days. Jeanne always takes excellent care of him, and we always pick him up in perfect health.

You can trust her completely!

We left our cat at La Maison des Ronrons for a month this summer. Jeanne reassured us after a bad experience with another cattery. We left feeling completely at ease and were delighted to receive regular updates!

I share the opinion of previous clients.
My cat almost died! I picked him up dirty, over a kilo thinner, and in a deplorable state. He had to be hospitalized and put on an IV drip.
Despite the manager's kindness (who still didn't check on me after my sick guest left), the cattery is undoubtedly a victim of its own success, and only the strongest cats will survive in such a large group.

Excellent guesthouse, I highly recommend it!

Professional and attentive staff.
The manager is passionate, and it makes all the difference. Thank you!
Uby was very happy with his first stay at the purring house!! I highly recommend it, your furry friends will be in very good hands!!

I got my 5-month-old cat back after a 20-day stay. Despite the very kind owner, she came back completely listless. Emaciated and lifeless, she's no longer my Rukia. I thought it was psychological, but after a week of lethargy, no reaction to play, and refusal to eat, I took her to the vet. She tested positive for feline herpesvirus (FHV-1). She was already a little thin, but now she's anorexic. She's in a life-or-death situation. An epidemic spreads incredibly quickly in a group setting. I'm forced to syringe-feed her and give her antibiotics, without even knowing if she'll survive. I beg you, if you care about your cat, this is not the right place. Cats in group settings are terrible. Keep your cats away and take proper care of them.

Thank you, Jeanne, you love cats so much that we can leave with peace of mind knowing they are loved and pampered. What's incredible is the serene atmosphere among them; they live in perfect harmony without even knowing each other because they feel comfortable and safe. Well done! My cats were happy and on vacation too, thank you!

For the past two years, whenever I go away, I leave my cat Sushi at La Maison des Purrons. And what peace of mind it gives me!

I know Jeanne takes care of our animals as if they were her own. That is to say, with a lot of attention and love. She gives us regular updates, and I can see that Sushi is having a wonderful time with his friends and with Aunt Jeanne.
Out of the thirty or so stays, Sushi has never come back sick or unwell, despite living in a group setting. This is a risk we accept when we choose to leave our cat in a group setting rather than at home with a cat sitter who comes by. In short, thank you, Jeanne, for everything you do for us and our little darlings. I highly recommend you.

I left my cat at Jeanne's boarding facility for three weeks during my vacation. I left feeling calm and stress-free because I know how well Jeanne cares for our pets. She's very professional and gives us regular updates, which is reassuring. The facility is very spacious, clean, and well laid out so our animals can play, climb the walls, or rest.

I highly recommend La Maison des Ronrons (The House of Purrs); even my cat loves going there now!! 😁👍🏼👍🏼

We entrusted our cat, Vanille, to this boarding facility, thinking we were offering her a safe place while we were away. She had diarrhea, and we requested that she be isolated for her comfort. Unfortunately, since our return, she has been vomiting frequently and is very weak.

We are devastated to find her in such a state. It is clear that something was not handled properly, and we had hoped for serious veterinary follow-up given these worrying signs.

This experience has left us deeply uneasy. We no longer trust this boarding facility.

I left my cat for a weekend in July and he came back with cat flu. I spent the night at the emergency vet to find out what was wrong with him because he was sneezing intensely and very frequently, had diarrhea, was urinating outside the litter box, and most importantly, a fever. My cat was completely lethargic, without any energy. Even though it helped me out a few times during the summer, I won't be doing that again…

I entrusted my baby Yuki to Jeanne this summer of 2025, and everything went well. Jeanne kept me informed by message about the stomach flu outbreak at the daycare and offered to arrange a vet visit. I trusted her with Yuki, and I picked him up very happy after his stay with his friends.

Thank you, Jeanne, for your hard work, which I know requires a lot!

I am writing in support of Julie, whom I accompanied after her cat's stay at the boarding facility. The animal was unrecognizable: emaciated, dirty, and clearly in poor condition. I am not here to criticize the boarding facility, but to defend animal welfare. I know how much Julie cares for her companions, and the contrast with her cat's condition upon her return is alarming.
I have no doubt that the boarding facility has good reviews and is certainly reliable on a daily basis. But faced with an overload of cases, the priority was clearly no longer the animals' care—perhaps in favor of financial considerations. What worries me most is the manager's lack of self-reflection, as if the seriousness of the situation completely escaped her. Our animals cannot speak for themselves: it is up to us to defend them.

Two weeks... A long stay for Myrtille, who has now returned home. She didn't call a family meeting to complain about her "vacation" and seems, just like last time, happy to have made friends in addition to the kind hotel owner.

We had our Dexter looked after this summer at "The House of Purrs," and everything went very well. Jeanne is a trustworthy person who took excellent care of our cat. I think Dexter will happily return to Jeanne's.

Unfortunately, twice over, I entrusted my two cats to "La Maison des Ronrons" for 10 days, and both were infected by another sick cat and have feline herpesvirus (FHV-1). This disease is potentially fatal for cats.

Avoid at all costs! The photos and the manager's good intentions do not compensate for her negligence in hygiene.

Our cat jumped out of the window last night and got lost in the neighborhood. I went to see if he'd been taken in at the cattery and was so touched by the kindness, help, and advice I received from the manager. She offered to search the neighborhood, put up a missing cat poster at the cattery, and took my contact information in case she found him.

Thank you so much for your help! Our cat has been found and is doing well now.

We've already entrusted our cat to La Maison des Ronrons twice, and both stays have gone very well. We'll continue to use their services for our next vacation!
Jeanne was perfect with our Gisèle 🫶🏼 …
Our cat spent 15 days here in winter and is going back for 3 weeks this summer. We are very happy and feel very confident. I highly recommend them. Anne, Lyon 8

I highly recommend her! We entrusted our cat, Randy, to Jeanne for two weeks. We regularly received photos and videos of Randy. Jeanne adores cats and takes care of them as if they were her own. Thank you again for your kindness! ✨

I left my cat for a week in July 2025 after the settling-in period. Everything went very well, and the place is fantastic. Communication with Jeanne was always very clear and friendly. It was lovely to receive updates with photos/videos from time to time!

Thank you 😊

We entrusted our cat to Jeanne for four days for a trial stay. She's a very shy and timid cat, so unfortunately, she didn't adapt well to the group environment. That said, Jeanne was incredibly kind throughout her stay. She did everything she could to make her feel comfortable (keeping an eye on her, sending daily updates, leaving food near her hiding place, etc.). You can tell she truly loves animals and does everything she can for their well-being.
Ultimately, our cat will probably feel better at home, but I wouldn't hesitate for a second to call on Jeanne for in-home pet sitting!

My cat had his adaptation stay there. I thank Jeanne for her patience and understanding.
He was very intimidated and stressed at first, and I picked him up from a walk with his tail held high three days later. He'll be going back in August for a week.
BONUS: Updates via WhatsApp

I entrusted my cat Ulysses to Jeanne for the weekend and everything went perfectly. She took excellent care of him, ensuring his comfort, giving me regular updates, and sending reassuring photos. I recommend her without hesitation!

I entrusted my two cats to her for a three-day initial settling-in period. Despite their very different personalities (one is timid), everything went very well: they almost gave me the cold shoulder when I brought them home ;)
Jeanne takes wonderful care of her guests: I would recommend her to my friends and family without hesitation.

The added bonus: receiving regular photos and videos.

For about six months now, we've regularly entrusted our cat Moon to Jeanne when we go on vacation or for a weekend. Moon is naturally anxious and reserved, but over time, she has truly blossomed with Jeanne. Today, we leave with complete peace of mind, knowing that Moon is in good hands and feels comfortable there.
We've entrusted our cat to Jeanne many times, for weekends or entire weeks, and everything has always gone wonderfully. Our cat doesn't want to leave now!
Great place to have your cats looked after. Jeanne is a very pleasant person, attentive and very available.
A fantastic experience for both us and our old cat! Lots of photos/videos to keep us updated, he's going back to the House of Purrs tomorrow for his second stay 🥰 thank you! …

Discovered by chance while looking for a cattery for my cat, Jeanne was quickly available and contactable to help us organize this stay.
From the very beginning, you can sense the professionalism, attentiveness, and thoroughness needed to provide the best possible care for our furry friends.
The plus: her primary interest in adaptation stays, which are essential to ensure the cattery is a good fit for your cat.
The cattery is clean, the cats are relaxed, and receive all the attention they need.
I highly recommend it!
Thank you to Pension des Ronrons 👋🏽

Fantastic place, even suitable for a difficult cat like mine! First, a two-day trial stay to make sure everything was going well, then almost a week-long stay which went wonderfully! Jeanne is passionate and lovely, very attentive to both cats and their owners!

I left my cat Simba for an 11-day stay. I was quite anxious about leaving him for the first time with someone I didn't know, but Jeanne's professionalism reassured me immensely. She welcomed Simba gently, respecting his pace and needs. The settling-in period was very beneficial, ensuring his stay went smoothly. The photos and videos I received of Simba during his stay showed me that my cat was more than comfortable with Jeanne and the other cats. Thank you to her for all the love she gives them. I wholeheartedly recommend her and will continue to leave Simba at La Maison des Ronrons without hesitation.

We left our young cat with Jeanne twice: for a full week in August 2024, and for a weekend at the end of June for her settling-in period. We appreciated communicating with Jeanne, the atmosphere she creates in her cattery, and how well she organized things to welcome our little Zaïa (who is very timid). We received three videos during her stay; it was a pleasure to get updates!
We highly recommend her, and we will definitely leave Zaïa at La Maison des Ronrons again!

We were able to leave our cat with Jeanne last summer.
Jeanne is very pleasant, professional, and attentive to the owners' needs. Everything went very well, and we were delighted with the experience.
My cat was great and even came back wiser, she is still young and I took her in off the street. Jeanne is a professional and attentive person.

I was able to leave my cat for an adjustment period before his two-week stay. Communication with Jeanne was very smooth and pleasant. I'm delighted I was able to leave my cat at this boarding facility; I highly recommend it!
Jeanne took very good care of my cat, she knew how to reassure him and gave me updates every day.

Cachou spent two days, each lasting a month, at the Maison des Ronrons: everything went very well each time! Jeanne has a real gift for putting her residents at ease and pampering them, the hygiene of the establishment is remarkable, and Jeanne regularly sends photos/videos of her charges. A big thank you to her for her professionalism, kindness, and enthusiasm!
A very good experience for my cat; Jeanne is very kind and attentive. I highly recommend her.

I can 100% recommend this cat boarding facility. My little Zazou loved it! The manager is very friendly and attentive to her clients. I received updates on my kitten every day. I've never seen him have so much fun, and I picked up a very calm kitten.
What's also great about this boarding facility is that the cats aren't kept indoors all day; they can roam around and meet other cats.
Myrtille had a wonderful stay at this cat hotel. The hostess was very kind and passionate. The comfort and cleanliness were remarkable.

I hired Jeanne to look after my little Mimine for four days while I was away. Jeanne is lovely, attentive, and passionate about her work. She genuinely loves animals and all the cats she cares for. You can trust her completely, whether at her daycare or at your home; she'll take excellent care of your cat. Thank you again! See you soon! 🥰

Ruby had the opportunity to visit the purring house twice. Being so small, I was afraid she'd stay in her corner and feel abandoned, but it was quite the opposite!
She quickly settled in, and it was good for both of us. I'm going to take her one weekend a month so she can have fun with her friends. A big thank you to Jeanne for her professionalism and patience :)

The owner is super friendly and the cattery is very well maintained!
The cats are treated impeccably and are in wonderful conditions to thrive.
I highly recommend it to all cats, big or small! 🐱🥰 …

I highly recommend La Maison des Ronrons! We left Nala there for two weeks – she's quite solitary and has a strong personality. Everything went wonderfully. She settled in perfectly! They have plenty of equipment adapted to each cat's needs (acclimation crate, cat tree, cushion). Jeanne is incredibly attentive and gentle. You can tell she knows cats and their behavior well, and that's fantastic!
A fantastic owner!

I am absolutely delighted with my experience at La Maison des Ronrons. Everything went perfectly. Jeanne is a kind, professional young woman who listens attentively to cat owners. The introductory stay offered before my booked stay helped to completely reassure me, and I felt totally confident.
Therefore, I wholeheartedly recommend La Maison des Ronrons for your cats' stay.

I highly recommend this cattery! 👍 I left my cat Choubaka in the capable hands of La Maison des Ronrons for three months while I was traveling abroad. Thanks to my initial communication with Jeanne, who was incredibly helpful, I left with complete peace of mind. She truly adores cats, knows them well, and does everything she can to reassure owners. From the very first minutes at the cattery, Choubaka felt comfortable in the very clean and well-designed space that Jeanne had created, even though he had never been in a group setting before. And personally, I love the decor, which changes with the seasons (Choubaka had the ball pit, floats, and palm trees this summer! 😁). Jeanne also regularly provides updates on our cat during his stay, with photos and/or videos, which is much appreciated. Furthermore, Choubaka had two serious health problems this summer (including a heart issue), and Jeanne did everything she could for him and for me to ensure he received the care he needed while I was abroad. I thank her again for that and wouldn't hesitate for a second to entrust Choubaka to her care again. ❤️

Fantastic cattery for cats. It has everything they need to feel comfortable. You can tell Jeanne is passionate about cats and has a great understanding of them, especially how they behave in a group. My cat has stayed at La Maison des Ronrons twice, and both stays went very well, even though he's not used to being around other cats. I highly recommend it!

Despite my short weekend stay, it was much appreciated to receive a video update about my cat!
All the cats were very welcoming, and Jeanne seemed very attentive to their …

Looking for a boarding facility for Kuro in Lyon this summer, Jeanne was a great help. Kuro was in good hands with her and the gang of black cats 😊.
Thank you for the updates throughout his stay. 😸 …
We've left our little furball Peanut with Jeanne and her team several times, and the stay was more than perfect! With regular updates via messages and a generous dose of love, we'll gladly return ;)

First time for my little Godzilla this summer... lots of panic and worry for me (lol) but everything went well!
The welcome was fantastic, Jeanne is very understanding and does everything she …

I highly recommend this place; you can trust them completely. My cat is a stressed, anxious cat. He had never been to a cattery before and ended up getting used to it. Jeanne is a very reliable person. Thank you again.

Fantastic cattery! My cat felt right at home. They provide high-quality food and plenty of toys and places to rest. Plus, we're kept very well informed with a short video of our cat on WhatsApp every day. I highly recommend La Maison des Ronrons!

I took my 10-month-old cat with me while I was on vacation and left him for 4 weeks. I was worried about leaving him for so long, but it went very well. The team is great and gives frequent updates; they're very attentive to the cats. I have absolutely no complaints! :)

It's so nice to know that a place like La Maison des Ronrons exists.

It allows me to leave peacefully and with the relief that my two little darlings …
